landing.heroTitle: Trade the world's markets. Every exchange, every ticker, in real time. Risk nothing.
landing.heroBody: Access stocks, crypto, gold, and mutual funds through one powerful platform built for speed, clarity, and control. Track opportunities as they move and manage your portfolio with confidence

landing.fastTrackBody: Place an order against the live price and watch your position, cash and rank move the moment it fills.
landing.securityLead: From account access to asset protection, every layer of our platform is designed with security, privacy, and trust at its core.
landing.sec1Body: We use multiple layers of security to protect your account, personal information, and trading activity. From secure authentication to continuous system monitoring, every layer is designed to help prevent unauthorized access and keep your account protected.
landing.sec2Body: Your personal and financial information is protected using modern encryption technology. Data is secured both while it moves across our platform and when it is stored, helping ensure your sensitive information remains private and protected.
landing.sec3Body: Your investments and funds deserve the highest level of protection. We apply strict safeguards around client assets and maintain clear separation between customer funds and operational assets, providing greater transparency and security.
landing.sec4Body: Security doesn't stop when you log out. Our systems continuously monitor account activity and transactions for unusual patterns or suspicious behavior, helping identify potential threats early and providing an additional layer of protection for your account.
landing.closingTitle: Market updates, straight to your inbox.
landing.closingBody: Subscribe for our newsletter and product updates - market moves worth knowing about, new features as they ship, and the occasional note on how the platform works. No noise, and nothing you did not ask for.
landing.partnersBody: Connected to the infrastructure behind modern investing.
landing.partnersNote: Names shown are market venues and trading firms whose infrastructure this platform models.

footer.blurb: HyperStocks gives traders live prices and virtual capital - making global markets easier to learn, practise, and master without risk.

about.title: One Platform. Multiple Markets. More Ways to Invest.
about.lead1: HyperStocks is a modern multi-asset investment platform designed to give individuals access to a broad range of global financial markets from one secure account.
about.lead2: From stocks and mutual funds to digital assets and gold, HyperStocks brings multiple investment opportunities together in one intuitive platform, giving investors the flexibility to build, manage, and diversify their portfolios on their own terms.
about.lead3: Our goal is simple: make investing more accessible, more transparent, and easier to manage.
about.statVolumeSub: Total value of transactions across supported markets.
about.statTradesSub: Transactions completed across our multi-asset platform.
about.statInvestorsSub: Individuals using HyperStocks to access and manage investments.
about.statAssetsSub: Total value of assets held across supported investment products.
about.statMarketsSub: Opportunities across stocks, crypto, gold, funds, and other supported investments.
about.accessP1: Financial markets can feel fragmented. Different assets often require different platforms, accounts, and tools.
about.accessP3: With a single HyperStocks account, investors can explore and manage exposure across stocks, cryptocurrencies, gold, and mutual funds, giving them greater flexibility to build portfolios around their individual goals, strategies, and risk preferences.
about.accessP4: Whether you're investing for the long term, diversifying an existing portfolio, or exploring new markets, HyperStocks gives you the tools to do it from one place.
about.assetStocksBody: Discover and trade shares of publicly listed companies across supported markets. Follow market movements, research opportunities, and manage your equity positions from one platform.
about.assetCryptoBody: Access the rapidly evolving digital asset market with a streamlined experience for buying, selling, and managing supported cryptocurrencies.
about.assetGoldBody: Gain exposure to one of the world's most recognized stores of value and diversify beyond traditional financial assets.
about.assetFundsBody: Explore professionally managed investment funds that provide access to diversified portfolios across different securities and strategies.
about.controlP1: Your investment strategy is personal. Your platform should be too.
about.controlP2: HyperStocks is designed to give investors greater control over how they manage their money. Instead of navigating multiple services to monitor different investments, you can bring your portfolio together in one connected experience.
about.controlP3: Track your holdings, monitor market activity, manage your account, and make investment decisions through a platform designed with simplicity and clarity in mind.
about.techP1: Markets move quickly. Your investment platform should keep up.
about.techP2: HyperStocks combines modern financial technology with an intuitive user experience to make market access simpler and portfolio management more efficient.
about.techP3: From real-time market information and portfolio tracking to streamlined trade execution and account management, we continue to build technology around the needs of today's investor.
about.securityP1: When your financial assets and personal information are involved, security is fundamental.
about.securityP2: HyperStocks is built with security and privacy at the center of the platform. We use layered safeguards designed to protect accounts, sensitive information, and trading activity while maintaining a secure environment for investors.
about.securityP3: We believe trust is earned through transparency, responsible practices, and consistent protection, not simply through promises.
about.portfolioP1: We don't believe there is a single way to invest.
about.portfolioP2: Some investors focus on individual companies. Others prefer diversified funds. Some seek exposure to digital assets or commodities. Many combine different asset classes to build a portfolio aligned with their objectives.
about.portfolioP3: HyperStocks gives you the flexibility to decide what belongs in your portfolio.
about.portfolioP4: Our role is to provide the infrastructure, technology, market access, and tools that help you manage those decisions.
about.nextP2: Traditional markets, digital assets, alternative investments, and new financial technologies are increasingly becoming part of the same investment ecosystem. HyperStocks is building a platform designed to evolve alongside that changing landscape.
about.nextP3: Whether you're taking your first step into investing or actively managing a diversified portfolio, HyperStocks gives you a modern place to access and manage the markets.
about.nextP4: One account. Multiple asset classes. One connected investment experience.
about.ctaBody: Start building your portfolio with HyperStocks today.
